info.title: Dorf Remote Control API
info.description: The authenticated, purpose-built remote boundary for one Dorf Deployment. A Session is the long-running resource; internal Tasks, AgentRuns, Actions, and providers are not exposed as resources. Timeline reads expose native Harness, Thread, and Turn references without granting control over them.

get.summary: Discover the Deployment and its capabilities

200.description: Deployment discovery

get.summary: Read the canonical OpenAPI document and Problem catalog

200.description: OpenAPI 3.1 JSON document

post.summary: Redeem one short-lived Enrollment for a Client

200.description: Exact replay of an already redeemed Client binding

get.summary: Inspect the effective Principal and Client

200.description: Authenticated identity

get.summary: List Sandbox profiles available for Session selection
get.description: Returns all configured profiles in name order, including unverified profiles. Verification reflects stored proof for the current definition, not a live availability check. Infrastructure configuration and credentials remain private.

200.description: Narrow Sandbox profile summaries

get.summary: List one newest-first page of Sessions
get.description: This is keyset traversal of current Session facts, not a frozen snapshot. Pass next_cursor unchanged to retrieve the next page.

200.description: One page of narrow Session summaries

post.summary: Admit or exactly replay a direct Session

200.description: Exact replay of the admitted Session
Current complete Session representation

304.description: The supplied representation ETag is still current

get.summary: Read completed replies and inputs in the Message's native turn
get.description: A passive read of the exact bound turn, including completed final replies before the turn settles. Entries preserve native order. Use thread_id, turn_id and index to identify retained entries; native_item_id is diagnostic only. Input message_id is present only when verified against Dorf custody. Missing binding or unavailable history returns timeline_unavailable.

200.description: Completed conversation entries available at read time

get.summary: Read one native conversation turn without starting work
get.description: Returns original userMessage and agentMessage objects in native order. Omitted turn_id selects the latest started turn once. Unavailable, unsupported, oversized, or incomplete history fails without truncation.

200.description: Native conversation turn available at read time

get.description: A non-durable server-sent event stream. Each snapshot event carries an id equal to the canonical representation digest and data containing one complete Session JSON object. Keepalives are comments. Reconnect by reading the canonical Session or by supplying the last event id; the stream closes for bounded reauthentication.

200.description: Server-sent snapshot events and keepalive comments

post.summary: Admit or exactly replay a follow or steer Message

developer_instructions.description: Complete application developer instruction snapshot; an omitted part leaves it unchanged and an empty part clears it for a fresh Turn.

text.description: Verbatim Message text. May be empty when attachments are present.

attachment.description: Ordered files sent by value with a filename. Dorf derives media type, kind, byte size, and SHA-256. Each file is limited to 8 MiB. Fully decoded PNG, JPEG, and static WebP inputs become image attachments and are limited to 25,000,000 decoded pixels; all other bytes become file attachments.

200.description: Exact replay of the accepted Message
Current retained Message delivery

get.description: Use latest as the Message selector to inspect the latest settled reply in the main Sandbox.

put.summary: Request interruption of the exact Turn for a direct Codex Message
put.description: Idempotent. A Steer addresses its original Turn, never a successor. A settled target is a no-op. Inspect the result for the observed outcome.

200.description: Current Message after accepting Stop or observing a settled target

post.summary: Retry the Session's eligible failed execution

200.description: Exact replay of the retry request
Current complete Session representation after accepting the request

put.description: Atomically replaces one regular file inside the Sandbox, up to 128 KiB, with mode 0600. Creates missing parent directories with mode 0700. Accepts absolute paths, ~/ paths relative to the Sandbox execution user home, and paths relative to the workspace. Rejects symlinks and non-canonical paths. If-None-Match: * creates only when absent; an existing regular file is preserved and also returns 204. Cleanup fences apply to the entire write.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Clean absolute, home-relative (~/), or workspace-relative Sandbox file path

204.description: File written, or existing file preserved for create-only setup

get.summary: Read exact bytes from one Session-owned Sandbox
get.description: Reads up to 8 MiB from one regular file inside the Sandbox using an absolute, home-relative (~/), or workspace-relative path while Session cleanup still permits reads. Rejects symlinks and non-canonical paths. The client must verify Content-Digest before using or writing the bytes.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Clean absolute, home-relative (~/), or workspace-relative Sandbox file path

200.description: Exact file bytes

Content-Digest.description: RFC 9530 SHA-256 digest in structured-field form

409.description: The file exceeds the 8 MiB read limit

get.summary: Observe provider state without waking or pausing the Sandbox

200.description: Fresh provider observation; unknown means an unrecognized provider state

post.summary: Execute a bounded command inside an owned Sandbox
post.description: Runs argv once with optional text stdin and a bounded deadline. Returns exit code and capped text output. No idempotency key or automatic retry: a transport failure may leave the command outcome unknown. Session ownership and cleanup fences apply.

200.description: Command finished

get.summary: Read coherent Message outcome and completed replies
get.description: One coherent durable delivery/outcome and completed native reply projection. Binding and contiguous completed indexes identify entries; native IDs are diagnostic. An opaque cursor binds the exact Message and consumed-prefix digest. This explicit read may hydrate authoritative retained history if the ephemeral cache is missing or gapped. It does not fetch terminal result text separately. A completion watermark proves the complete final prefix as well as durable outcome; outcome alone is not sufficient.

200.description: Coherent Message observation

get.summary: Stream coherent Message outcome and completed replies
get.description: One coherent durable delivery/outcome and completed native reply projection. Binding and contiguous completed indexes identify entries; native IDs are diagnostic. An opaque cursor binds the exact Message and consumed-prefix digest. Native events drive observation SSE frames. Each data field is MessageObservation; id is its cursor when bound. At-least-once reconnect may replay entries. Compact durable-status checks settle outcome without native history polling. A missing ephemeral cache returns resync_deferred; gaps require explicit observation or timeline hydration. Subscription and heartbeats never resume a Sandbox or count as activity. Streams remain open after complete, ending within one minute for authentication renewal; reconnect with the last fully processed cursor.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Alternative to cursor; if both are supplied they must match.

200.description: Coherent Message observation

schema.description: SSE observation events whose data is MessageObservation.

clientBearer.description: One opaque, individually expiring and revocable Dorf Client credential.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Caller-retained request identity. Exact replay returns the same resource; changed input returns idempotency_conflict.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: One or more canonical representation ETags

PageCursor.name: cursor
PageCursor.description: Opaque cursor returned as next_cursor by the preceding page

ETag.description: Strong SHA-256 identity of the complete canonical Session representation

Problem.description: A Dorf-origin failure. The top-level x-dorf-problems catalog defines every stable code. An ingress failure may not use this representation.

Allow.description: Allowed method or methods when code is method_not_allowed

Retry-After.description: Seconds until another attempt when code is rate_limited

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge when code is unauthenticated

provider_id.description: Freshly attested provider resource locator, when present

index.description: Zero-based order among completed inputs and final replies in this retained turn.

native_item_id.description: Native diagnostic reference. May change across active and persisted reads.

text.description: Complete nonempty final reply text. Present on replies only.

message_id.description: Verified Dorf input Message identity, when known. Present on inputs only.

items.description: Original native userMessage and agentMessage objects, including phase and content, in native order.

OpenAPIDocument.description: The canonical OpenAPI 3.1 document. Its full recursive shape is defined by the OpenAPI specification.

capabilities.description: Supported feature names for this Deployment. Clients must ignore names they do not recognize; openapi identifies this document, session_list identifies paginated Session listing, and profile_list identifies Sandbox profile discovery.

credential.description: Client-generated secret; Dorf stores only its digest and never returns it.

verified.description: Stored verification matches the current profile definition and contract, and its probe and cleanup completed without an error. This is not a live readiness check or a guarantee that Session admission will succeed.

profiles.description: All configured profiles sorted by name; an empty deployment returns an empty array.

keep_running.description: Disable pause between turns for this Session. E2B pauses idle Sandboxes by default; other providers retain their existing lifecycle. Does not bypass provider timeouts.

client_reference.description: Optional opaque caller thread or task reference; retained at admission. Empty means no reference.

agents_md.description: Initial workspace AGENTS.md, installed before the Harness starts

profile.description: Named verified profile; omitted or empty selects the Deployment default

ai_connection.description: Named AI connection; omitted or empty selects the Deployment default

model.description: Harness model override; omitted or empty selects the resolved AI connection's default. The admitted Session always returns the exact resolved model.

client_reference.description: Optional opaque caller thread or task reference; retained at admission. Empty means no reference.

created_by_client.description: Authenticated creator of the first admission; null for unattributed Sessions. Revoked Clients remain identifiable.

GitCommitOID.description: Exact lowercase full Git commit OID: 40 hexadecimal characters for SHA-1 or 64 for SHA-256

ReasoningEffort.description: Omitted admission input defaults to high; Session responses always contain the effective value

keep_running.description: Disable pause between turns for this Session. E2B pauses idle Sandboxes by default; other providers retain their existing lifecycle. Does not bypass provider timeouts.

client_reference.description: Optional opaque caller thread or task reference; retained at admission. Empty means no reference.

created_by_client.description: Authenticated creator of the first admission; null for unattributed Sessions. Revoked Clients remain identifiable.

latest_reply_id.description: Latest settled reply in the main Sandbox, derived from retained Messages and AgentRuns. Pending follow-ups and steer acknowledgements are excluded.

observation.description: Deliver application-generated text rather than human input. Requires follow or auto intent, no attachments, and a supporting profile. Retained on idempotent replay.

developer_instructions.description: Complete application developer instruction snapshot for a fresh Turn. Omitted or null leaves the current snapshot unchanged; empty clears it. Steer retains this immutable payload but never changes the active Turn or defers it to another Message. Idempotent replay requires the same value.

refresh_skills.description: Request an installed-skill reload on a supported profile (currently Codex). A follow refreshes before its fresh Turn. A steer leaves the running Turn unchanged and retains the request for the next fresh Turn. Auto uses its resolved delivery intent. Retained on idempotent replay.

text.description: Verbatim Message text. JSON requests require nonempty text; multipart requests may use empty text when attachments are present.

intent.description: Steer active work or follow when idle, resolved once at admission.

interrupt_requested.description: Stop was accepted for this exact Turn; the result reports its observed outcome.

wait_reason.description: Accepted input is waiting for a durable workspace delivery hold to be released.

MessageResult.description: A settled result whose internal encoded observation is limited to 16 MiB.

timeout_seconds.description: Execution timeout in seconds; zero or omission uses 30 seconds.

SandboxCommand.description: Run explicit argv without implicit shell interpretation. Combined argv and stdin must not exceed 64 KiB; arguments must not contain NUL and argv[0] must be nonempty.

exit_code.description: Process exit code. Nonzero is a command result; 124 indicates the execution timeout expired.

truncated.description: One or both output streams exceeded 64 KiB and were truncated.

cursor.description: Opaque exact Message/binding and consumed-prefix digest cursor. Persist only after processing the entire returned suffix.

completion_watermark.description: Final completed-prefix count, present only after authoritative native terminal history and durable outcome settle. Failure before native binding has zero watermark.
